```sql
with captures as (
    select
        a.attempt_id,
        a.amount_minor,
        a.business_date,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
            order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
        ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'captured'
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and ci.name = 'Salem'
),
weekend_sales as (
    select
        coalesce(sum(case
            when business_date between date '2026-09-05' and date '2026-09-06'
            then amount_minor
            else 0
        end), 0) as latest_weekend_sales,
        coalesce(sum(case
            when business_date between date '2026-08-29' and date '2026-08-30'
            then amount_minor
            else 0
        end), 0) as previous_weekend_sales
    from captures
    where capture_rank = 1
      and business_date between date '2026-08-29' and date '2026-09-06'
)
select
    null as key,
    case
        when latest_weekend_sales > previous_weekend_sales then 1
        else 0
    end as value
from weekend_sales
order by value
```
